text:
```yaml
name: Tag Report

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v0.9.1'

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v0.9.1
          name: Release v0.9.1
          body: |
            ## 🎉 Release v0.9.1

            **Version**: v0.9.1  
            **Type**: Patch (Bug Fix + Enhancement)  
            **Date**: 2025-10-30

            ### ✨ What's New

            #### Features
            - **Automatic UV Tool Cache Refresh** (SPEC-UPDATE-CACHE-FIX-001)
              - Auto-detects stale PyPI metadata
              - Seamlessly retries upgrade after cache clear
              - Users no longer need to run upgrade twice

            #### Bug Fixes  
            - Fixed double-run issue in `uv tool upgrade moai-adk`
            - Python 3.13 CI/CD workflow compatibility

            #### Documentation
            - Added troubleshooting guide (README)
            - Release notes in CHANGELOG
            - Complete SPEC documentation

            ### 📊 Quality Metrics
            - ✅ Tests: 572 passing
            - ✅ Coverage: 56.76%
            - ✅ Type Check: Passed
            - ✅ Security: No vulns
            - ✅ TAGs: 13 verified (100% integrity)

            ### 📦 Installation
            [code omitted]

            **Note**: This PR uses squash merge to maintain clean main branch history.
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
